policy.automaticScope: Verified reusable Database improvements, including existing/new skills and necessary supporting code, rules, roles, registration and configuration; direct normal push after independent review and affected checks. Consumer data and environment permission bypasses remain excluded.

learning.store: Authorized scoped sanitized Markdown lessons; existing Memory Vault optional
learning.proposalPublication: reviewed direct push of verified sanitized lessons; defer unproven lessons locally
learning.deduplication: source revision, capability and evidence; cross-PC paths are not identity

orchestration.primary: The main AI orchestrates scoped subagents, verifies evidence and integrates results
orchestration.modelSelection: Per task from available host models and supported reasoning; packaged roles inherit unless explicitly overridden at launch
orchestration.parallelism: Independent lanes within host limits; isolate write ownership
